last_summary: Replication Watch 08:00Z (gear 1; no gear-2 fallback). 3 new validation records in 3 domains, none of them previously on the rail; Yard validations 24 -> 27. INSTITUTIONAL FLAG, +1 LENR: Hylenr (Hyderabad) completed Phase 1 of a study of its BRT-NiUCS-2 hydrogen-loaded Ni-Pd lattice-confinement reactor in the Department of Nuclear Engineering, Texas A&M University (Prof. Lin Shao's lab), announced 21-22 Sep 2026; reported RGA on an SRS RGA 100 showing helium and argon 2-3 ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE above background with no nitrogen rise, a higher operating temperature than a calibration device at comparable input power, and SEM/EDX catalyst changes. CORROBORATED independently this run: the live ICCF-27 program lists Session 3, Mon 31 Aug 2026 16:20-16:45, 'Nuclear Signatures in a Hydrogen-Loaded Ni-Pd Lattice Confinement System' by Agastya Rao, Lavanya Upadhyaya, Anthony Cecchini - Rao is Hylenr's Principal Research Lead, Cecchini is a TAMU Nuclear Engineering PhD under Lin Shao; the calorimetry arm (Tue 1 Sep 09:45) is company-only. Verdict on Dossier 021's own checklist = INCONCLUSIVE, not a pass: no calorimetry in the heat arm, no paper in the nuclear arm (iccf-27.org/proceeding still 200/9,845B 'Under Construction', re-verified ~3 weeks post-conference), prosaic noble-gas readings unexcluded (the company's named discriminators SIMS/ICP-MS/isotopes are deferred to Phase 2), and independence is PARTIAL BY CONSTRUCTION because the university co-authored. Dossier 021's Hylenr 'watch only' line is now dated. +1 TORSION/SCALAR - FIRST RECORD IN THE FAMILY: Peng Gao, rxiv 2608.0099 (24 Aug 2026), Shkatov torsimetry (GRG-001 detector) reading the truth value of a statement about an NBA total; N=19 sessions, 60 samples per scan, two scans per session ('total score > theta' certainly false vs '< theta' certainly true); delta-TC positive in 19/19, mean +112.1, SEM 8.8, p = 2^-19 ~ 2x10^-6. Confidence LOW and the reason is STRUCTURAL, not statistical - the protocol cannot be blinded because the operator knows which statement is impossible, and it runs no sham pair, no pre-registered theta, no randomised scan order, no second operator; filed as a measurement of an operator-instrument pair, not of a text, with the five-line re-test named in the record. +1 ELECTRO-CULTURE - FIRST POSITIVE on the rail after two nulls: Zhenyu Liu's group, Shanxi Agricultural University, Engineering Agriculture 13(4):26668 (2026), DOI 10.15302/J-FASE-2026668, 25 days of positive high-voltage electrostatic field on tomato seedlings; magnesium enriched in leaves to 1.58x control, membrane hyperpolarisation and reduced impedance, chlorophyll/stomatal conductance/Rubisco up with intercellular CO2 held stable, mechanical strength and biomass up; negative polarity reported to inhibit late ('promotion first, inhibition later'). Recorded PRESS-RELEASE DEEP: every number arrives via the publisher's own EurekAlert release (18 Sep 2026), the paper was not readable from this sandbox, and field strength, electrode geometry, n and the field-off control are absent - so confidence is medium that the study says this, low-medium that it generalises. The three records on this rail (passive millivolt dowels null; constant magnetic field null; active HVEF on seedlings positive) are different experiments, not a score; the composite the Yard can honestly state is that the claim is dose-, polarity- and delivery-dependent. FEED: practical.validations 24 -> expected 27. The whole-feed builder was DELIBERATELY NOT run from this sandbox - blob:none partial clone with no working tree, translations/ not carried by the repo, and both my own memo and the seeder's 09-24 entry record that this path zeroes the published counters. The feed is cron-owned: aflinks-cron rebuilt it at 07:10:37Z today with the full builder (archive 93,839 / 144 translations / 3,779 pages / 24 validations), so the records land at the next bake; growth verified by API against the remote tip rather than asserted. CAPTURED, NOT FILED: the ICCF-27 program is live and is the freshest map of LENR replication in progress (Pd-Ni multilayer excess heat during hydrogen desorption, Sasaki/Tohoku; hot spots in wet-prepared nanostructured NiCu, Iwamura; heat bursts in Pd/D2O electrolysis, Valat-Czerski/Szczecin; Celani Constantan; Benyo multi-state IEF+LCF; Huang excited-17O water) - titles only, proceedings unpublished, so no records written from them; they are the next run's queue and the Szczecin title is the most interesting because that group's reputation is careful nuclear-physics method. No promises; claimed/attempted/measured/reported; canonical name 'Aether Force'.
